title: Degradation-Consistent Test-Time Adaptation for All-in-One Image Restoration
authors: Ni Tang; Shenghao Nie; Xiaotong Luo; Yuan Xie; Yanyun Qu
method_family: TTA for all-in-one image restoration (re-degradation generator + dual consistency + Fisher parameter selection)
supervision: self-supervised at test time (no GT; teacher pseudo-label from 8x geometric-augmentation ensemble)
target_data_access: unlabeled target image, one at a time (batch=1 streaming)
online_or_offline: online streaming; EMA teacher eta=0.95; lr 2e-4
uses_source_images: no (frozen theta0 only; source data not needed at test time)
update_object: model parameters; full-parameter test-time SGD restricted by a one-shot diagonal-Fisher importance mask that freezes the top rho=0.4 fraction, computed ONCE before TTA
risk_definition: NONE explicit: no accept/reject, no rollback, no comparison against the frozen anchor; the only reference signal is an unsupervised consistency loss and a teacher pseudo-label
extra_network_cost: HIGH: RDDM diffusion degradation generator (5 steps) + VGG perceptual term + 8-way augmentation teacher ensemble, every step
data_available: public (Kodak24-Poisson; O-HAZY; DenseHaze; Rain100H; RealBlur; LOLv2-real)
weights_available: not located (repo is code-only as inspected)
relevance_to_B: R5 critical: this is the single closest prior art. Re-degradation residual + teacher consistency + degradation-aware parameter selection already coexist in one method
key_limitation: No per-update utility estimate; no keep/accept/reset action; no delta against the frozen anchor; the importance mask is estimated once, so harm accumulated after step 0 is never re-examined; evaluated on generic degradations, never on underwater data; pseudo-label is the ONLY reference, so a confidently wrong teacher is unrecoverable

title: Re-Degradation and Contrastive Learning for Zero-shot Underwater Image Restoration
authors: Nisha Varghese; A. N. Rajagopalan
method_family: zero-shot underwater restoration; re-degradation consistency + contrastive learning
risk_definition: none reported at update level; consistency residual only
relevance_to_B: R4 high: establishes that RE-DEGRADATION for UIE predates DCTTA. Our re-degradation-residual evidence is therefore NOT novel as a signal
key_limitation: Re-degradation is used as a training objective, not as a decision statistic; no accept/reject, no anchor comparison, no risk event; zero-shot per-image so nothing accumulates across the stream

title: Shot-Again: Self-Supervised Underwater Image Enhancement With Transmission-Space Regularization and Structure-Channel Feature Regulation
authors: Shiyao Feng; Chunru Wan; Jun-Hong Cui; Gaochao Xu
method_family: self-supervised UIE; re-degradation + transmission-space regularization + structure-channel regulation
risk_definition: none (no online risk concept)
relevance_to_B: R4 high: explicitly frames re-degradation as a SOFT cue rather than an exact physical law, which is exactly the physical-proxy-mismatch caveat our B-framing leans on
key_limitation: Offline self-supervised training only; no test-time adaptation, no per-update control, no online stream

title: Domain Adaptation for Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Zhengyong Wang; Liquan Shen; Mei Yu; Kun Wang; Yufei Lin; Mai Xu
method_family: transductive unsupervised domain adaptation for UIE (dual image+feature alignment; easy-hard curriculum; rank-based underwater IQA pseudo-labels)
supervision: unsupervised DA (unlabeled real target set; RUIQA pseudo-label ranker)
target_data_access: the WHOLE unlabeled target set (transductive batch)
uses_source_images: no source images at test time (source model + target set)
update_object: network parameters, trained on the full target set in two phases
risk_definition: none at update level; the RUIQA ranker is the quality proxy
relevance_to_B: R4 high: the canonical UIE domain-adaptation baseline we must beat on the no-target-reference axis, but it is TRANSDUCTIVE, so it is a SEPARATE track from causal prequential B, not a row in the main table
key_limitation: Needs the entire target set before producing any output; not causal; cannot be run image-by-image; no per-update risk; reports only UCIQE/UIQM/color-error/RUIQA - no PSNR/SSIM at all

title: Monitoring Risks in Test-Time Adaptation
authors: Mona Schirmer; Metod Jazbec; Christian A. Naesseth; Eric Nalisnick
method_family: risk monitoring for TTA via sequential testing / confidence sequences
supervision: label-free monitoring (uses a labeled reference/calibration set to define the criterion)
update_object: none - it does not change the model; it watches the TTA loop and raises ALERTS
risk_definition: STREAM-LEVEL: raises an alert when a predefined performance criterion is violated over the stream (did the run degrade past a bar)
data_available: classification/segmentation benchmarks (RobustBench/ImageNet-C and WildTime pipelines in the repo)
relevance_to_B: R5 critical: the only explicit 'risk' framework for TTA, and the thing reviewers will point at when we say 'risk-controlled'
key_limitation: Monitors the STREAM, not a candidate update. It answers 'is the deployed run failing yet', not 'will THIS update help or hurt, and by how much, relative to keep-current and reset-to-frozen'. Binary alert, no per-update action, no benefit retention, no dense restoration, no anchor object

title: Test-Time Degradation Adaptation for Open-Set Image Restoration
authors: Yuanbiao Gou; Haiyu Zhao; Boyun Li; Xinyan Xiao; Xi Peng
method_family: test-time degradation adaptation with a pretrained degradation-agnostic diffusion model + test-time adapter
uses_source_images: no (source stays frozen; adapter is meta-learned offline)
update_object: a lightweight degradation adapter (+ guided diffusion sampling)
risk_definition: none
extra_network_cost: VERY HIGH: gradient-guided diffusion sampling per image
relevance_to_B: R4 high: proves test-time adaptation for restoration is already mainstream; also proves the compute objection we will face
key_limitation: Episodic per-image; heavy inference; no streaming state, so no accumulation problem and no need for keep/accept/reset; no explicit harm/benefit decision

title: Low-Level Continual Test-Time Adaptation for Image Restoration
authors: Ye Liu; Wubin Gao; Youchen Chen; Fan Lyu; Xing Wang
method_family: continual TTA for low-level restoration (D2TTA): teacher-student + SVD feature projections + contrastive alignment + uncertainty-guided filtering
risk_definition: uncertainty-guided filtering of unreliable supervision (a per-sample gate, not a per-update utility)
relevance_to_B: R5 critical: the closest 'continual TTA for restoration' claim. It already filters unreliable supervision and already worries about structure preservation
key_limitation: Filtering decides which SAMPLES to learn from; it never decides whether the resulting UPDATE is beneficial. No delta vs keep-current, no delta vs frozen anchor, no rollback, no false-accept accounting

title: TTTIR: Unlocking Instance-Specific State Evolution via Test-Time Training for Image Restoration
authors: Kaihang Zheng; Jun Li; Hang Guo; Hongyu Chi; Zimo Liu; Tao Dai; Jinpeng Wang; Yaowei Wang
method_family: test-time training that generates instance-specific operators for restoration
risk_definition: none
relevance_to_B: R4 high: another 2026 entry that already reframes restoration as instance-specific state evolution, i.e. the 'state' vocabulary is taken
key_limitation: No harm/benefit decision, no anchor, no risk event; per-instance so no cross-image accumulation; not underwater; preprint, not peer reviewed at time of writing

title: Restoring without Forgetting: Filter-Level Continual Image Restoration via Parameter-Space Integrated Gradients
authors: Xin Feng; Jin Zhao; Yizhen Zhang; Wenjie Pei; Fanglin Chen; Guangming Lu
method_family: continual learning for restoration; parameter-space integrated-gradients attribution to localize degradation-critical filters; factorized low-rank task filters
update_object: a small set of task-specific filters generated from a filter bank; the base stays intact
risk_definition: forgetting measured empirically across tasks; no online risk event
relevance_to_B: R4 high: occupies the 'which parameters may change' slot with a much stronger attribution story than a Fisher mask
key_limitation: Offline task-incremental, not label-free online TTA; no per-update accept/reject; the unit of decision is a TASK, not an update

title: Restoring Without Forgetting: Continual Learning Across Image Degradations
authors: Alif Ashrafee; Bartosz Krawczyk
method_family: continual learning across sequentially encountered degradations
supervision: supervised within each task; no replay of past data
risk_definition: catastrophic forgetting measured after the fact
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: names the accumulation problem we care about, but in the task-incremental setting with per-task supervision
key_limitation: Requires task boundaries and per-task training; not label-free; not per-update; no dense-restoration risk statistic

title: Continual Test-Time Domain Adaptation
authors: Qin Wang; Olga Fink; Luc Van Gool; Dengxin Dai
method_family: continual TTA: weighted pseudo-labels + stochastic restoration + teacher EMA
update_object: model parameters; stochastic restoration randomly resets a fraction of weights back to the source values
risk_definition: none - restoration is RANDOM, not risk-triggered
relevance_to_B: R4 high: it already contains a 'reset to source' action. Our reset must be shown to be better than RANDOM reset, not better than no reset
key_limitation: Random restoration is risk-agnostic: it fires on a schedule and ignores whether the current update helped; no utility estimate; classification only

title: Towards Stable Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Wild World
authors: Shuaicheng Niu; Jiaxiang Wu; Yifan Zhang; Yaofo Chen; Shifeng Zheng; Peilin Zhao; Mingkui Tan
method_family: stable TTA: batch-agnostic normalization + sharpness-aware minimization + reliable-sample selection
risk_definition: entropy-based reliability score used to DROP samples before the gradient step
relevance_to_B: R4 high: reliable-sample selection is the strongest existing 'gate the update' idea and a mandatory baseline for us
key_limitation: The gate is on the SAMPLE (is this input trustworthy), never on the UPDATE (did this parameter change help). Entropy is a classification quantity with no dense-restoration analogue; no anchor, no rollback

title: Efficient Test-Time Model Adaptation without Forgetting
authors: Shuaicheng Niu; Jiaxiang Wu; Yifan Zhang; Yaofo Chen; Shifeng Zheng; Peilin Zhao; Mingkui Tan
method_family: TTA with anti-forgetting regularization: active sample selection + Fisher regularizer + margin-based filtering
update_object: model parameters, regularized toward the source by a Fisher-weighted penalty
risk_definition: a Fisher-style anti-forgetting penalty bounds drift implicitly; no explicit risk event or decision
relevance_to_B: R4 high: 'anti-forgetting via Fisher' is exactly the cheap baseline a reviewer will demand against our explicit anchor term
key_limitation: Soft regularization, not a decision: it shrinks updates but never refuses one, and cannot distinguish a good large update from a bad large one; no per-update utility; classification only

title: Robust Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Scenarios
authors: Longhui Yuan; Binhui Xie; Shuang Li
method_family: robust continual TTA with a memory bank and robust batch-norm estimation
update_object: model parameters + a category-balanced memory bank
risk_definition: none explicit
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: another memory/robustness approach to the same instability we target
key_limitation: Memory of past samples mitigates but does not evaluate updates; no accept/reject; classification

title: Tent: Fully Test-time Adaptation by Entropy Minimization
authors: Dequan Wang; Evan Shelhamer; Shaoteng Liu; Bruno Olshausen; Trevor Darrell
method_family: test-time entropy minimization; adapts normalization statistics + affine parameters
update_object: BN statistics and affine parameters only
risk_definition: none
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: the canonical 'always update' baseline our gate must beat; also the origin of the always-adapt default we argue against
key_limitation: Unconditional update; entropy is meaningless for a dense regression restoration output; no risk notion at all

title: Test-Time Training with Self-Supervision for Generalization under Distribution Shifts
authors: Yu Sun; Xiaolong Wang; Zhuang Liu; John Miller; Alexei Efros; Moritz Hardt
method_family: test-time training with an auxiliary self-supervised rotation task
update_object: a shared feature extractor plus a per-input prediction head
risk_definition: none
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: the conceptual ancestor of 'adapt at test time'; episodic, so no accumulation
key_limitation: Episodic; requires an auxiliary task whose validity under the target shift is assumed, not checked; no risk control

title: SPARNet: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Sample Partitioning Strategy and Anti-Forgetting Regularization
authors: Xinru Meng; Han Sun; Jiamei Liu; Ningzhong Liu; Huiyu Zhou
method_family: continual TTA: sample partitioning + anti-forgetting regularization
update_object: model parameters with an anti-forgetting term
risk_definition: implicit via regularization; no explicit risk event
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: same 'noisy pseudo-labels cause error accumulation' diagnosis we make, but the remedy is sample partitioning
key_limitation: Partitions SAMPLES by pseudo-label quality; does not evaluate the parameter delta; no keep/reset decision, no anchor

title: Continual Test-time Domain Adaptation via Dynamic Sample Selection
authors: Yanshuo Wang; Jie Hong; Ali Cheraghian; Shafin Rahman; David Ahmedt-Aristizabal; Lars Petersson; Mehrtash Harandi
method_family: continual TTA with dynamic thresholding + positive/negative learning
update_object: model parameters; per-sample positive/negative pseudo-label weighting
risk_definition: a dynamic threshold on prediction confidence acts as an implicit quality gate
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: the 'dynamic threshold' family we must beat and must also use as a matched-rate baseline
key_limitation: Threshold is on the sample's pseudo-label confidence, not on the update's effect; no anchor; classification only

title: Self-Bootstrapping for Versatile Test-Time Adaptation
authors: Shuaicheng Niu; Guohao Chen; Peilin Zhao; Tianyi Wang; Pengcheng Wu; Zhiqi Shen
method_family: test-time self-bootstrapping: consistency between the test image and a geometrically-preserving deteriorated view
risk_definition: none
data_available: classification, object detection and pixel-level tasks
relevance_to_B: R4 high: extends TTA to PIXEL-LEVEL predictions with a deteriorated-view consistency objective - i.e. the exact mechanism DCTTA uses for restoration, already generalized
key_limitation: Consistency is the objective, not a decision statistic; the deteriorated view is assumed to preserve what matters, with no test of that assumption; no harm/benefit decision

title: AETTA: Label-Free Accuracy Estimation for Test-Time Adaptation
authors: (CVPR 2024 proceedings paper)
method_family: label-free accuracy estimation for a TTA run
risk_definition: estimates the accuracy of the adapted model over the stream
relevance_to_B: R4 high: the strongest existing 'estimate how the adaptation is doing without labels' method, and therefore the natural label-free baseline for our predictor
key_limitation: Produces a stream-level ACCURACY number, not a per-candidate-update signed delta; tied to classification correctness, which has no dense-restoration analogue; no action, no benefit retention

title: Conformal Risk Control
authors: Anastasios N. Angelopoulos; Stephen Bates; Adam Fisch; Lihua Lei; Tal Schuster
method_family: distribution-free risk control via conformal prediction
supervision: supervised calibration set + unlabeled test point
risk_definition: bounds the EXPECTED risk of the chosen rule at a user-specified level with a finite-sample guarantee
relevance_to_B: R4 high: supplies the formal vocabulary ('risk control at level alpha') that our 'risk-controlled' title invokes, and therefore the assumption a reviewer will attack
key_limitation: Requires EXCHANGEABILITY (or a known bounded non-exchangeability model). A test-time adaptation stream violates it BY CONSTRUCTION, because the model changes as a function of past test data. Risk is bounded for a fixed rule, not for a rule that selects among candidate updates

title: Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability
authors: Rina Foygel Barber; Emmanuel J. Candes; Aaditya Ramdas; Ryan J. Tibshirani
method_family: conformal prediction under distribution drift / non-exchangeability
update_object: prediction sets with coverage guarantees under a drift model
risk_definition: coverage guarantee parametrized by an assumed drift bound
relevance_to_B: R4 high: it is the honest escape hatch for our non-exchangeability problem, and constraining us to state an explicit drift assumption rather than hand-waving
key_limitation: The guarantee is only as good as the assumed drift model; in a TTA loop the drift is CAUSED by our own decisions, which is a feedback loop none of these results cover

title: When Should We Intervene at Test Time?
authors: Jiahao Zhang; Xinling Wen; Liangliang Li; Yu Chen
method_family: learned controller (PORTAL) that decides WHEN to deploy an intervention and WHICH inputs to label
supervision: REQUIRES TARGET LABEL FEEDBACK (active label acquisition)
target_data_access: unlabeled stream plus a label-acquisition budget
update_object: none - selects among fixed candidate prediction rules instead of changing parameters
risk_definition: each candidate rule's realised accuracy on acquired labels; the controller stops when the remaining labels cannot change the leader
relevance_to_B: R5 critical: this is the nearest CONCEPTUAL neighbour - 'should I intervene, and is the gain worth the evidence' - and it is a 2026 preprint we must cite and differentiate
key_limitation: It BUYS LABELS. With no target reference images (our setting) there is no feedback channel, so none of its machinery applies. It also selects among fixed rules rather than judging a parameter update, and gives no per-update signed delta against a frozen anchor

title: A Decision-Theoretic View of Test-Time Training: When, How Far, and Which Directions to Adapt
authors: Tomoya Wakayama
method_family: theory of test-time training as implicit Bayesian inference in the kernel regime
update_object: update step size and update subspace (which blocks/heads)
risk_definition: PAC-Bayes bound against overfitting when the update step is selected by prompt evidence
relevance_to_B: R5 critical: it already answers 'how far and which directions to adapt' with a guarantee in a classification/TTT setting. We must not claim novelty for the question, only for the dense-restoration operationalization
key_limitation: Gaussian-process / linear-Gaussian benchmark; classification-style TTT; no restoration, no dense perceptual metric, no re-degradation physics, no online unlabeled stream. Its 'evidence' is the prompt, not a restoration residual

title: WWE-UIE: A Wavelet and White Balance Efficient Network for Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Ching-Heng Cheng; Jen-Wei Lee; Chia-Ming Lee; Chih-Chung Hsu
method_family: fully supervised efficient UIE backbone (wavelet + white balance)
risk_definition: none
weights_available: not verified (code public; checkpoint release not confirmed)
relevance_to_B: R4 high: the strongest recent efficient UIE method and our most likely source-model / target-supervision coordinate
key_limitation: Fully supervised on the target domain: it is an ABSOLUTE COORDINATE, not a no-target-label baseline; its per-dataset 8:1:1 splits differ from the LSUI 3879/400 split used by U-shape and UniUIR, so its numbers are NOT directly comparable to theirs

title: SDUIE: Semi-Supervised Diffusion for Underwater Image Enhancement with Quant-Text Dual Control
authors: Xiaofeng Cong; Yu-Xin Zhang; Hao Shen; Yeying Jin; Junming Hou; Jie Gui
method_family: semi-supervised diffusion UIE with quantized + text dual control
risk_definition: none
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: a 2026 UIE headline method we must acknowledge, but it is NOT comparable on a PSNR table
key_limitation: CRITICAL FOR THE REGISTRY: it reports ONLY no-reference metrics (UIQM/UCIQE/URANKER) - no PSNR and no SSIM anywhere in the paper. Listing it beside PSNR rows would be a category error

title: UniUIR: Considering Underwater Image Restoration as An All-in-One Learner
authors: Xu Zhang; Huan Zhang; Guoli Wang; Qian Zhang; Lefei Zhang; Bo Du
method_family: all-in-one supervised underwater restoration (multi-degradation single model)
risk_definition: none
data_available: public (UIEB-T/T90; LSUI-T/LSUI-400; U45; SQUID-16; Challenge-60; UCCS; EUVP-330)
relevance_to_B: R4 high: supplies the cleanest published PSNR/SSIM reference points on the UIEB-T90 and LSUI-400 splits, i.e. the exact splits closest to our locked transfers
key_limitation: Fully supervised in-domain; no adaptation, no unlabeled target, no risk. Its numbers are only a ceiling coordinate

title: AquaClarity: Vision Transformer Enhances Underwater Image via Nonlinear Feature Fusion and Color Fidelity Improvement
authors: Xuhang Chen; Zimeng Li; Xiujun Zhang; Yingtie Lei; Yihang Dong; Xiaofeng Zhang; Chi-Man Pun
method_family: fully supervised ViT UIE (nonlinear feature+spatial fusion; color fidelity block)
risk_definition: none
data_available: public (Kaggle underwater benchmark dataset linked from repo)
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: a fully supervised UIE coordinate; useful as a backbone option, not as a TTA comparator
key_limitation: Fully supervised; no adaptation; no cross-domain protocol; recent but not a no-reference-method

title: WaterLUT: A Lightweight and Generalizable Framework for Real-Time Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Xiuna Zeng; Zhenqi Fu; Peixian Zhuang; Xiaotong Tu; Yue Huang; Xinghao Ding
method_family: 3-D LUT + prompt-guided lightweight UIE
risk_definition: none
relevance_to_B: R3 medium: the efficiency frontier; relevant if our gate must be cheap enough to sit inside a real-time UIE loop
key_limitation: Fully supervised, no adaptation, no risk; LUT capacity limits how much a test-time update could even express, which is a caveat for using it as a TTA source model

title: U-shape Transformer for Underwater Image Enhancement
authors: Lintao Peng; Chunli Zhu; Liheng Bian
method_family: supervised UIE transformer; ALSO the origin of the LSUI dataset and its 3879/400 split
risk_definition: none
data_available: public (LSUI Train-L 3879 / Test-L400 400; UIEB Train-U 800 / Test-U90 90; EUVP Train-E)
relevance_to_B: R4 high: defines the LSUI split our locked transfer uses, and is the standard UIE baseline that every UIE table quotes
key_limitation: Older and beatable; its value to us is the SPLIT DEFINITION and the paired data, not its accuracy

title: Bag of Tricks for Fully Test-Time Adaptation
authors: Saypraseuth Mounsaveng; Florent Chiaroni; Malik Boudiaf; Marco Pedersoli; Ismail Ben Ayed
method_family: systematic ablation of TTA tricks (small-batch BN; stream rebalancing; reliable sample selection; confidence calibration)
update_object: normalization / parameters depending on the trick
risk_definition: treats TTA as noisy learning and studies which tricks suppress harm
relevance_to_B: R4 high: it is the paper that will be cited to say 'sample selection and calibration already handle this'; we must show it does not, at matched cost
key_limitation: Its conclusion is that tricks are ORTHOGONAL and additive - i.e. it explicitly does not propose a per-update decision object; classification only

title: Evaluation of Test-Time Adaptation Under Computational Time Constraints
authors: Motasem Alfarra; Hani Itani; Alejandro Pardo; Shyma Alhuwaider; Merey Ramazanova; Juan C. Perez; Zhipeng Cai; Matthias Mueller; Bernard Ghanem
method_family: evaluation protocol for TTA under a wall-clock/compute budget
target_data_access: unlabeled stream arriving in real time
risk_definition: penalizes slow methods by giving them fewer samples to adapt on
relevance_to_B: R5 critical for protocol: our prequential protocol must answer the 'your controller costs compute' objection, and this is the accepted way to do it
key_limitation: Provides the protocol, not a method; no risk object; classification framing only

title: Estimating Model Performance Under Covariate Shift Without Labels
authors: Jakub Bialek; Juhani Kivimaki; Wojtek Kuberski; N. Perrakis
method_family: label-free performance estimation under covariate shift
risk_definition: estimates post-deployment performance without labels
relevance_to_B: R4 high: the general 'can you estimate your own quality without labels' literature we must position against, and the reason our claim must be about a SIGNED PER-UPDATE delta, not about estimating overall quality
key_limitation: Estimates a scalar performance level under covariate shift, assuming the shift is not caused by the estimator; gives no per-decision action and no sign of an individual update
